### 🟢 Approval recommended There are no active review issues for the change aligning async upsert behavior with the synchronous API. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR aligns async upsert behavior in `langchain-sqlserver` with the synchronous API, allowing existing rows to be replaced instead of failing on duplicate IDs. **Changes:** - Adds keyword-only `upsert=False` to `aadd_texts` and forwards it to the async insertion helper. - Deletes matching rows before inserting replacements in the same transaction when upsert is enabled. - Adds a regression test comparing async and sync delete-before-insert behavior. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `libs/​sqlserver/​tests/​unit_tests/​test_vectorstores_async.py` | Adds recording session mocks and an async/sync upsert parity test. | | `libs/​sqlserver/​langchain_sqlserver/​vectorstores.py` | Documents and implements async upsert while preserving the default insert-only behavior. |
Review effort: Balanced
